_about: Public-domain Charles Moss, Bishop of St David's and then of Bath and Wells, for the Word Hoard: The Evidence of the Resurrection Cleared, its Sequel, and his sermons before the Lord Mayor, the House of Lords, the governors of the Salisbury Infirmary, and the Society for the Propagation of the Gospel. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 122 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

moss-evidence-resurrection: The evidence of the resurrection : cleared from the exceptions of a late pamphlet entitled "The resurrection of Jesus considered by a moral philosopher, in answer to The tryal of the witnesses, etc." (London : Printed for John and Henry Pemberton, 1744)
moss-lord-mayor-1750: A sermon preached before the Right Honourable the Lord-Mayor, the Court of Aldermen, the Sheriffs, and the Governors of the several hospitals of the City of London, at the parish church of St. Bridget, on Tuesday in Easter-Week, 1750. By Charles Moss (catalogued 1750)
moss-st-james-1756: A sermon preached at the parish church of St. James, Westminster, on Friday, February 6, 1756. being the day appointed by His Majesty for a general fast, on occasion of the late earthquakes, and the present situation of public affairs. By Charles Mos (catalogued 1756)
moss-lords-1769: A sermon preached before the House of Lords, in the Abbey church of St. Peter, Westminster, on Monday, January 30, 1769, ... By ... Charles Lord Bishop of St. David's.  1769 (catalogued 1769)
moss-sarum-1770: A sermon, preached in the cathedral church of Sarum, before the governors of the General Infirmary, at their anniversary meeting, on Friday, September 29, 1769. By the Right Reverend Charles, Lord Bishop of St. David's.  1770 (catalogued 1770)
moss-spg-1772: A sermon preached before the incorporated Society for the Propagation of the Gospel in Foreign Parts, at their anniversary meeting in the parish-church of St. Mary-le-Bow, on Friday, February 21, 1772 (London : Printed by T. Harrison and S. Brooke, 1772)

_excluded.moss-others: the law, Greek reader, medical, botanical and Madagascar books are by other men named Moss
